item.title: Important notice for Iranian Ceno users
item.description:
During an internet shutdown, we regularly inject independent media pages into the network via satellite – the only way of connectivity that is not jammed now. As a result, Ceno Browser can continue to operate inside the country using Public Mode. In this mode, users can request web pages and share them with others, using p2p capabilities based on BitTorrent.
Download, use and share Ceno if you have any access in Iran.
